entries.reason: Applied the finding's second remedy: ADOPT_RATIO stays a ratio (a margin read as a share of the base's figure cannot be shift-free), the judge JSDoc and the PR body now say it is the one test a shift moves, and a test pins it. Charged both: the ticket's criterion 'adding the same shift ... leaves every verdict ... unchanged' was unmet as submitted, and the PR body and the judge JSDoc as submitted asserted that every verdict is left unchanged.

Applied: $ and minutes per merged PR now weigh stretches by Pulls (Mantel-Haenszel over Pull counts), a side's figure its weighted spend per Pull over its weighted merged PRs per Pull, so a merge-less stretch's spend counts; single-stretch figures are v/d exactly. Charged false-claim: the diff's comments asserted every Pull of a shared stretch is kept while its spend dropped out.
